agents.title: Agents
agents.subtitle: Manage bridged external agents (CLI / ACP). Agim Agent is the built-in default agent and is configured from the Agim Agent tab via Model APIs.
agents.installHint: Not installed. `npm install -g {{pkg}}` on the host.
agents.nativeInstallHint: No model API configured for Agim Agent. Open Settings → Agim Agent to add one (OpenAI / DeepSeek / Anthropic / …).
agents.inProcessHint: built-in — runs inside agim, no external CLI to install
agents.agimAgentCardDesc: Agim Agent runs inside agim and uses Model APIs you configure. It is separate from bridged external agents on this page.
agents.defaultAgentHint: Used when the intent classifier has no preference (new web threads, etc.). Only enabled + online agents appear here.

acp.title: Remote agents (ACP)
acp.subtitle: Agents reachable over HTTP via the Agent Communication Protocol. Each entry persists in config and registers on the next service restart.
acp.baseUrlHint: Probes `<base>/.well-known/acp` and adds the entries it lists. Skips names already present.
acp.name: Name
acp.endpointHint: Base URL of the agent's ACP root (no trailing `/`).
acp.dupName: An agent with this name already exists.

empty.title: No remote agents
empty.description: Add an ACP endpoint below or use Discover for a `.well-known/acp` directory.

toast.testMasked: Save first — token is masked, can't test in place.

policy.title: Policy & toggles
policy.subtitle: Frequently used switches backed by environment values. Each toggle is saved immediately and usually takes effect at once; a few settings still require a service restart.

safety.title: Skip permissions (DANGEROUS)
safety.description: When ON, the Claude Code adapter passes `--dangerously-skip-permissions` to the wrapped CLI, bypassing every tool-use confirmation. Recommended OFF for production. Only enable for trusted, isolated workspaces.
safety.tagWarn: production deployments should keep this OFF

autoApprove.title: Auto-Approve
autoApprove.description: Enabled by default. Tool calls are approved immediately after safety checks (sensitive-path deny + self-protect), without sending IM approval cards or waiting for any timeout. Turn off to fall back to the timeout-based approval flow.

approval.title: Approval timeout default
approval.description: What happens when auto-approve is off and a pending tool-use request expires with no human reply. `Allow` is the default (auto-approve on timeout); `Deny` is strict interactive mode. Irrelevant when auto-approve is on.
approval.timeoutDescription: Seconds an IM approval card waits for a user response when auto-approve is off. Saving writes the env value; the running approval bus needs a service restart to adopt a new duration.

memory.title: Long-term memory
memory.description: Master switch for the per-user memory subsystem (facts + persona + vector retrieval). Disabling stops new fact extraction and persona consolidation; the existing bank stays on disk.

viewer.title: Long-message viewer
viewer.description: When ON, IM replies that exceed the viewer threshold are uploaded to the local paste store and the IM message becomes a short URL the user can click. Without it, long replies get truncated by the messenger.

a2aNotify.title: A2A notify mode
a2aNotify.description: How verbose the bus is when one agent calls another. `essential` (default) sends only headline events; `verbose` includes every transition; `off` silences cross-agent notifications entirely.

messengers.title: Messengers
messengers.subtitle: Per-IM-platform connection settings. Toggle a platform on, fill in its credentials, and Save. The next service restart picks up the new config.

quick.title: Connect one messenger
quick.subtitle: Pick a path first. WeChat uses QR login; Feishu, DingTalk, and others need app credentials from their developer consoles.
quick.connectedDetail: Connected: {{platforms}}. Open Web chat to verify it, or add another messenger.

wechat.title: WeChat QR
wechat.detail: Fastest path. Scan with WeChat on your phone and confirm the login.

feishu.title: Feishu app
feishu.detail: Good for company chats. Requires App ID, App Secret, and message scopes.

dingtalk.title: DingTalk Stream
dingtalk.detail: Good for company chats. Requires Stream API client credentials.

telegram.title: Telegram bot
telegram.detail: Good for global groups. Requires a Bot Token from BotFather.

discord.title: Discord bot
discord.detail: Good for community channels. Requires a Bot Token and bot invite.

apply.title: Apply IM changes
apply.restartDetail: Saved. Restart Agim to connect the enabled messengers.
apply.startDetail: Saved. Start Agim to connect the enabled messengers.

hint.wechat: iLink-based QR login. Click Scan, scan the QR with your phone WeChat, confirm — the bot logs in as that account.
hint.telegram: Bot API token from @BotFather; channel id is optional and only used when targeting a specific chat.
hint.feishu: App credentials from the Lark developer console. App must have the messaging scopes.
hint.dingtalk: Stream API client credentials from the DingTalk developer console.
hint.discord: Bot token from the Discord developer portal. The bot must be invited to the target channel.

dingtalk.accountsHint: Each entry starts its own DWClient with isolated dmPolicy / allowFrom / ack-reaction. Restart agim after Save for new accounts to take effect.
dingtalk.accountsEmpty: No extra accounts yet. Click ‘+ add account’ to wire another DingTalk bot.
dingtalk.accountRenameCollision: An account with id "{{id}}" already exists; pick another id.

qr.title: Scan WeChat QR
qr.description: Open WeChat on your phone, scan this code, then confirm the login prompt inside WeChat.
qr.expired: QR code expired — close and start a new one.
qr.confirmed: Login confirmed — wechat-ilink will start on the next service restart.

email.title: Email (SMTP)
email.subtitle: Outbound mail delivery for `/remind email me@x.com …`. Credentials persist to `~/.agim/.env`. Leave blank to disable.
email.userHint: Login email; often the sender address too.
email.passHint: Stored in `~/.agim/.env` (chmod 600). Masked unless Reveal is on.
email.fromHint: Sender header. Defaults to the username when blank.
email.secureHint: `auto` follows the port; force SSL or STARTTLS if your provider requires it.

viewerSettings.title: Viewer & Maps
viewerSettings.subtitle: Public-facing surfaces: the long-message Viewer (turns >threshold replies into a `/v/<id>` short link) and Baidu Maps AK (drives `/memo` address geocoding).

viewer.title: Viewer (long-message links)
viewer.subtitle: Replies longer than the chars / lines threshold are uploaded to the local paste store and the IM message becomes a short `/v/<id>` link.
viewer.publicUrlHint: What the operator's reverse proxy / tunnel exposes. Used to build `/v/<id>` links.
viewer.tunnelHint: `quick` launches a Cloudflare quick tunnel and uses its URL when the operator hasn't fronted agim themselves.
viewer.remotePasteUrlHint: POST markdown here to get a public URL back; overrides Public base URL + tunnel. Leave empty to use the community default https://viewer.iclaw.host/paste.
viewer.remotePasteTokenHint: Optional bearer token sent to the remote paste server. Required only if your paste server protects POSTs.
viewer.noDefaultRemoteLabel: Don't fall back to viewer.iclaw.host when nothing else is configured
viewer.noDefaultRemoteHint: When no mode is configured, agim falls back to viewer.iclaw.host. Enable this to disable that fallback (long content stays inline unless another mode is configured).
viewer.binaryMissing: not found in PATH — install from cloudflare/cloudflared releases
viewer.charsHint: Replies above this length route through Viewer.
viewer.linesHint: Same routing decision, on line count.
viewer.codeLinesHint: Lower threshold for replies inside code fences.
viewer.maxPastesHint: Older pastes are evicted FIFO once the count exceeds this.

baidu.title: Baidu Maps AK
baidu.subtitle: Enables `/memo` address-to-coords lookup. Without it, /memo still works via raw coords or browser GPS share. Free AK: lbsyun.baidu.com → Console → Application → Server-side API.
baidu.hint: Stored in `~/.agim/.env` (chmod 600). Masked unless Reveal is on.
baidu.suspicious: AK length is {{length}} — usually a Baidu AK is 32 characters. Double-check?

workspaces.title: Access Scopes
workspaces.subtitle: Partition available Agents and call rates by user, team, or customer. `default` catches every unrouted user.

empty.title: Only the default scope
empty.description: Add a scope below to partition available Agents and call rates by team, project, or customer.

remove.label: Delete
remove.confirmDescription: After deletion, members of {{name}} fall back to the default scope. This takes effect immediately.

form.title: Add or edit access scope
form.subtitleEdit: Editing an existing scope — change id to clone, keep to upsert.
form.idHint: Stable identifier; [a-zA-Z0-9_-]+; the special name `default` is reserved.
form.name: Display name
form.agentsHint: Leave empty to allow every registered Agent; choose entries to restrict this scope.
form.membersHint: Leave empty to open this scope to every user; you can also add `platform:userId` manually.
form.ratePresetHint: Default uses the system rate limit; you can still edit the numbers below.

service.title: Service
service.subtitle: Inspect the running agim process + start, stop, or restart it.

actions.confirmStopDesc: The web console, the messenger adapters, and any in-flight job will all stop. You'll need to start the service again before you can use it.
actions.confirmRestartDesc: The process stops and re-starts. In-flight jobs are cancelled; outbox + queued reminders survive the bounce. The web console will be unreachable for ~5-30 seconds.

ports.title: Ports
ports.subtitle: Which ports agim binds when started. Leave blank to use the default. Changes apply on the next service restart (use the Restart button below after saving).
ports.webPortHint: HTTP server for the chat UI + REST API. Default: {{default}}.
ports.acpPortHint: Agent Communication Protocol server (remote agent surface). Default: {{default}}.
ports.invalidPort: Must be a number between 1 and 65535.

toast.saved: Ports saved — restart agim to bind the new ports

recovery.title: Recovery

detail.loading: Reading service status and the latest log lines.
detail.running: The service is running. If chat, IM, or an agent misbehaves, check the recent log or run the local doctor.
detail.booting: The service has started but is still in the {{phase}} phase. Wait briefly; if it stays there, check the recent log.
detail.stopped: The service is not running. Click Start above, then watch whether the recent log keeps updating.

commands.tailPendingDetail: It is created automatically after the first background service start.

security.title: Security
security.subtitle: Before sharing Agim, confirm who can reach the bot, who can administer it, and which high-risk tools are tightened.

posture.title: Security posture
posture.detail: Handle these before connecting public IM channels or a reverse proxy.
posture.readyDetail: The main access gates are in place. Advanced controls can still be tuned for your deployment.

skipPermissions.title: Agent permission confirmations are skipped
skipPermissions.detail: This bypasses tool-use confirmations and should only be used temporarily in isolated environments.

senderOpenImplicit.title: IM sender access is open
senderOpenImplicit.detail: Anyone who can reach the bot can start a conversation. Restrict it before sharing externally.

senderOpenExplicit.title: IM sender access is explicitly open
senderOpenExplicit.detail: Everyone is allowed by choice. For public groups or internet-facing access, use a restricted list.

adminEmpty.title: No IM admin configured
adminEmpty.detail: Admin-tier IM commands cannot be assigned safely yet. Ask the admin to send one message, then grant access.

envPerms.title: Env file permissions are too broad
envPerms.detail: Current mode is {{mode}}. Use 600 so other local users cannot read tokens or keys.

root.title: Service is running as root
root.detail: Tool calls inherit root privileges. Production deployments should run under a dedicated system user.

privateWeb.title: Native web can reach all private ranges
privateWeb.detail: This relaxes SSRF protection. Keep it on only for trusted internal deployments.

fsOpen.title: Native filesystem is not confined to the workspace
fsOpen.detail: By default it can access non-sensitive paths. Restrict it before external use.

diagnostics.title: Runtime diagnostics
diagnostics.summary: Open when troubleshooting; use the posture above for daily checks.
diagnostics.runningAsRootHelp: Tool calls run with root privileges. Recommend creating a dedicated user + setting User= in the systemd unit.

sender.title: Sender allowlist (who can talk to the bot)
sender.description: Controls who can message the IM bot. For external use, choose a restricted list from discovered users. For local personal testing, explicitly allow everyone.
sender.openHint: Anyone who can reach the IM bot can start a conversation. This is fine for personal testing; switch to a restricted list before public groups, company IM, or internet-facing access.
sender.emptyRestrictedToast: Restricted mode needs at least one selected or manual user.

exec.title: Native exec tool
exec.description: Sandbox + timeout controls for native_exec. Each invocation also goes through an IM approval card (unless previously auto-allowed by fingerprint).

web.title: Native web tools
web.description: SSRF defense and timeouts. CIDR whitelist lets you allow Tailscale / 100.64.0.0/10 / VPN ranges back in.
web.allowPrivateHelp: = 1 disables all private-IP checks. Only for trusted internal deployments.

fs.title: Native filesystem tools
fs.description: By default, fs tools can access non-sensitive paths. Turn this on to confine them to the native agent's per-thread workspace subtree.
fs.restrictOff: OFF (allow any path; sensitive-paths denylist still applies)

delegation.title: Native call_agent cap
delegation.description: Max mcp__agim__call_agent invocations per turn. Prevents native from spinning on infinite delegations. 0 = unlimited.

platformBlacklist.title: IM platform blacklist
platformBlacklist.description: Comma-separated platform ids. Listed platforms are hidden from the CLI wizard, from this admin page, and registry.registerMessenger refuses to register them at boot — even if their credentials still live in the env file the adapter won't come up. Default empty (no blocks). Common ids: wechat-ilink / telegram / feishu / dingtalk / discord / email.

admins.title: IM admin registry
admins.subtitle: Web admin tokens decide who can run IM admin-tier commands. Candidate IM users are auto-discovered after they send any message to agim.

known.title: Discovered IM users
known.hint: Users appear here automatically after they talk to agim. Grant admin directly from this list.
known.emptyHint: Ask the user to send one message to agim first.

remove.label: Remove
remove.confirmDescription: They lose access to all admin-tier commands. Re-add to restore.

llm.title: Agim Agent Settings
llm.subtitle: Add one model API first so Agim Agent can run. Multiple APIs, role bindings, and runtime behavior live under advanced settings. API keys are saved in ~/.agim/llm-secrets.json (0600) or AGIM_LLM_SECRET_<NAME>.

next.emptyTitle: Save and test the API above first
next.emptyDetail: After the test passes, Agim binds the default role and makes Agim Agent the default agent.
next.title: Next: send one message
next.detail: In chat, you can list and switch the model API used by this conversation.

advanced.title: Advanced settings
advanced.subtitle: Manage multiple APIs, role bindings, tool approvals, context compaction, A2A, notification evaluation, and heartbeat.

quick.title: Quick-enable Agim Agent
quick.subtitle: Pick a provider and paste an API key. Agim saves the API, binds the default role, and runs one connection test.
quick.readyDetail: Currently using {{backend}}. Open Web chat to test it.
quick.enableDetail: {{backend}} is usable. Enable it to bind Agim Agent and make it the default agent.
quick.setupDone: Agim Agent is enabled and the test passed.
quick.testFailed: Connection test failed. The API is saved; check the key, model, or Base URL.

llm.backendsEmpty: No model APIs configured yet. Add one below.
llm.rolesOptionalHint: Role bindings are optional. Native auto-uses any usable API.

errorDialog.title: Probe failed
errorDialog.defaultHint: Check the API key, Base URL, and model name. Details are below.
errorDialog.temperatureHint: This model does not accept the temperature parameter. Agim now sends temperature only when you explicitly configure it; run the probe again.

llm.removeConfirm: Remove API "{{name}}"? Role bindings and API key will be cleared.

roleHint.cheap: Used by built-in helper tasks such as memory extraction and intent classification.
roleHint.evaluator: Used by notification evaluation and route comparison.
roleHint.native-chat: Preferred for /agim chat (/na still works). If unbound, Agim Agent auto-falls back to any usable API.

llm.name: Name
llm.agimAgentRuntimeHint: Behavior controls below apply to Agim Agent. Model APIs above decide which models it uses.

mcp.title: External MCP Servers
mcp.subtitle: Tools from these servers are exposed to the built-in Agim Agent (via mcp_<server>_<tool> naming). CLI agents keep their own MCP configs and ignore this list. Header values may contain bearer tokens, so this page is admin-only.
mcp.serversEmpty: No MCP servers configured. Add one below — common picks: filesystem, github, postgres.

nativeAgent.title: Agim Agent · Evaluator · Heartbeat
nativeAgent.subtitle: Runtime controls for Agim Agent and two LLM-based gates (notification evaluator, heartbeat). Model APIs and optional role bindings are configured above on this page.
nativeAgent.roleHint: Agim Agent prefers this role first; when no role resolves, it auto-falls back to any usable API. Role bindings are optional.
nativeAgent.approvalHint: How tool calls from the Agim Agent loop are gated.
nativeAgent.autoAllowHint: Comma-separated. Tool names starting with any entry bypass the gate (e.g. native_,mcp_filesystem_).
nativeAgent.denyListHint: Comma-separated. Always rejected regardless of mode (e.g. mcp_shell_).
nativeAgent.evalDesc: LLM gate that filters routine / empty agent-initiated push messages. Uses the evaluator role. Fail-open: LLM error or missing API → message is delivered.
nativeAgent.evalSourcesHint: Comma-separated subset of: push, notify, reminder, heartbeat. Empty = default push,heartbeat.
nativeAgent.hbDesc: Periodic proactive wake-up loop. With this off, /heartbeat bind still works (saves the binding) but no scans run. Three-phase tick: DECIDE → EXECUTE → EVALUATE.
nativeAgent.tickHint: How often the scan loop checks due bindings. Default 60000.
nativeAgent.defaultIntervalHint: Minutes between ticks when a binding didn't specify one. Default 15.
nativeAgent.runtimeDesc: Limits for Agim Agent tool calls and retries. Leave blank to use defaults.
nativeAgent.toolResultCapHint: AGIM_NATIVE_TOOL_RESULT_MAX_CHARS. Truncates + appends a note. Default 64000.
nativeAgent.blankRetryHint: AGIM_NATIVE_BLANK_RETRY_MAX. Times to retry when the model returns empty text. Default 1. (⚠️ legacy loop only; not wired into the current Agim Agent)
nativeAgent.lengthRecoveryHint: AGIM_NATIVE_LENGTH_RECOVERY_MAX. Times to auto-continue on finishReason=length. Default 1. (⚠️ legacy loop only; not wired into the current Agim Agent)
nativeAgent.a2aDesc: Controls for model-triggered `mcp__agim__call_agent`, including depth and timeout limits. Agim→Agim calls use the built-in fast path by default.
nativeAgent.a2aMaxDepthHint: AGIM_A2A_MAX_DEPTH. Hard cap on nested call_agent chains. Default 1.
nativeAgent.callAgentInProcessHint: AGIM_NATIVE_CALL_AGENT_IN_PROCESS. Off falls back to the CLI subprocess. Default on.
nativeAgent.criticDesc: Semantic stuck-loop kills 3-strike same-intent across tools. Critic is an opt-in goal-divergence detector.
nativeAgent.semanticStuckLoopHint: AGIM_NATIVE_SEMANTIC_STUCK_LOOP. Enabled by default. Turn off to disable semantic cross-tool deduplication. (⚠️ legacy loop only; not wired into the current Agim Agent — its stuck-loop guard is the built-in "same tool + same args + 3 errors in a row")
nativeAgent.criticEnabledHint: AGIM_NATIVE_CRITIC. Off by default; on enables off-track early-stop reviews. (⚠️ legacy loop only; not wired into the current Agim Agent)
nativeAgent.criticRoleHint: AGIM_NATIVE_CRITIC_ROLE. Optional override (else uses main API). (⚠️ legacy loop only; not wired into the current Agim Agent)
nativeAgent.planModeDefaultHint: AGIM_NATIVE_PLAN_MODE. Default off; `/plan on` toggles per-thread regardless.
nativeAgent.planIntentAutoHint: AGIM_PLAN_INTENT_AUTO. When on, a prompt containing 先想想 / plan only / don't act yet temporarily enables plan mode for THAT turn only. Never auto-exits — user must /plan off or model must call native_exit_plan_mode.
nativeAgent.planIntentPhrasesHint: AGIM_PLAN_INTENT_PHRASES. Comma-separated. Empty = use built-in CN/EN defaults. Matching is case-insensitive substring.
nativeAgent.compactDesc: Summarize older turns when the conversation gets long, while preserving recent messages and the original goal context.
nativeAgent.compactTriggerCharsHint: AGIM_NATIVE_COMPACT_TRIGGER_CHARS. Set 0 to disable. Default 60000. (⚠️ legacy loop only; the current Agim Agent uses pi built-in compaction, this slider is not wired)
nativeAgent.compactKeepTurnsHint: AGIM_NATIVE_COMPACT_KEEP_TURNS. Tail size in user/assistant turns. Default 6. (⚠️ legacy loop only; the current Agim Agent uses pi built-in compaction, this slider is not wired)
nativeAgent.compactKeepFirstHint: AGIM_NATIVE_COMPACT_KEEP_FIRST. Preserves the earliest user goals. Default 1. (⚠️ legacy loop only; the current Agim Agent uses pi built-in compaction, this slider is not wired)
nativeAgent.compactSummaryCharsHint: AGIM_NATIVE_COMPACT_SUMMARY_CHARS. Cap on the LLM-generated summary. Default 1500. (⚠️ legacy loop only; the current Agim Agent uses pi built-in compaction, this slider is not wired)
nativeAgent.streamDesc: Streaming preserves partial text on IM's 30-min hard timeout. Max-iter is the worst-case tool-call ceiling.
nativeAgent.streamPartialHint: AGIM_NATIVE_STREAM_PARTIAL. Default on; off uses legacy non-stream path. (⚠️ legacy loop only; not wired into the current Agim Agent)

search.title: Web search providers
search.subtitle: Provider chain for native_web_search. On errors, requests fall through to the next provider. Clear a key to remove it; type to overwrite. Changes apply immediately.
search.savedToast: Saved. Next search will use the new chain.
search.chainHint: Resolved from AGIM_WEB_SEARCH_PROVIDERS; only entries whose available() is true appear.
search.keyHint: On Save, value is written to ~/.agim/env under {{envKey}}.

mobile.title: Mobile sign-in QR
mobile.subtitle: Generate a single QR code an operator can scan with a phone to open /m/chat. The scanned URL carries a fresh role=user token; on first scan the phone gets an auth cookie and lands inside the mobile chat.
mobile.generateDesc: Each click mints a NEW token (the previous QR keeps working until you revoke it). Operators with phones already signed in are not affected.
mobile.hostHint: By default the URL uses the same hostname:port this admin tab opened on. Override if your phone reaches agim via a different domain (e.g. cloudflared tunnel).
mobile.generatedToast: QR generated. Scan within sight of the screen.
mobile.scanDesc: Open the phone camera, point it at the QR. The phone will sign in once and stay signed in until the token is revoked.
mobile.urlHint: Anyone with this URL can sign in as the user role. Keep it private; treat it like a password.
mobile.tokenIdHint: Use this to find the token in the security page when you want to revoke it.
mobile.warningTitle: Treat the QR like a password.
mobile.warningBody: Scanned tokens persist until revoked. If a phone is lost, revoke the matching mobile-via-qr-* token in Security.
mobile.copyFailed: Copy failed; long-press the URL field instead.
mobile.qrAlt: QR code for mobile chat sign-in

skillInjection.title: System Prompt Skill Injection
skillInjection.subtitle: Tune the skill summary block injected into every system prompt. When the override file is non-empty, it replaces the auto-generated block (routing header and always-on skill bodies are still preserved).
skillInjection.overridePlaceholder: Leave empty to use auto. Common pattern: copy auto above, prune families you don't need, or prepend routing hints at the top.
skillInjection.largeWarn: Large block — watch your token budget
skillInjection.savedToast: Saved. Next turn picks it up.
skillInjection.rebuildTooltip: Rescan all SKILL.md on disk and regenerate the auto-generated block above (override below is unaffected).
skillInjection.rebuiltToast: Rescanned and rebuilt the auto-generated block. Picks up next turn.
skillInjection.overLimitToast: Body is {{len}} chars, over the {{max}} limit
skillInjection.confirmClear: Delete the override file and revert to auto-generated?
skillInjection.hint: No restart needed; the next system-prompt build reads the latest content.
